8.6.1 Mandatory interfaces
Note: This section defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill the core function-
ality of the module.
[SWS_Fls_00260] Definition of mandatory interfaces in module Fls ⌈
API Function
Header File
Description
Det_ReportRuntimeError
Det.h
Service to report runtime errors. If a callout has
been configured then this callout shall be called.
⌋(SRS_BSW_00469, SRS_BSW_00339) Note: If the flash device is connected via
SPI, also the SPI interfaces [6] are required to fulfill the modules core functionality.
Which interfaces are needed exactly shall not be detailed further in this specification.
